g.text: 1. Linear Warmup (Steps 0 -> T_warmup)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Prevents early gradient explosion during random weight initialization

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Linear Scaling Formula

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: lr_t = eta_max * (t / T_warmup)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Scales learning rate linearly from 0 up to eta_max (e.g. 3e-4)

g.text: Initial randomly initialized embeddings produce chaotic, noisy gradients

g.text: High initial learning rates cause AdamW second-moment running averages

g.text: (v_t) to overestimate variance, permanently corrupting early layers

g.text: Warmup allows layer normalization and attention maps to stabilize first!

g.text: 2. Cosine Decay (Steps T_warmup -> T_max)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Smooth monotonic decay settling weights into sharp, deep minima

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Cosine Annealing Formula

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: lr_t = eta_min + 0.5 * (eta_max - eta_min) * (1 + cos(pi * progress))

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Gradual decay down to eta_min (typically 10% of eta_max)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Generalization Advantage

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Decays much more smoothly than step-decay schedules

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Avoids sudden loss spikes when step reductions occur

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Allows weights to gently settle into the flattest, widest minima

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Maximizes out-of-distribution generalization on validation data
